caption:
A whale tail, right there, water still running off it. Then nothing but rings on the surface.
We hold our distance and let it choose. Some days we see nothing, and that is fine too.
Only five of us on board, so nobody is standing on anyone's toes.
Quietly one of the best minutes we have had out here.
Send us a message and we'll tell you what days are open.
